title.en: Attentive clinicians and dedicated veterinary staff

text.en: Clients frequently praise Dr. Smith, Dr. Reid, and the reception team on Westheimer Road for their warmth, attentiveness, and patience. Pet owners highlight that doctors take time to discuss medical conditions thoroughly without rushing appointments. Reviewers describe veterinary technicians as genuine animal lovers who maintain a supportive clinic atmosphere.

Reviewers emphasize the compassionate treatment their dogs, cats, and rescue kittens receive during every checkup and procedure. Owners report that staff treat visiting pets like their own, ensuring anxious companions feel relaxed and safe throughout treatment. Multiple clients note gentle care during dental surgery, bloodwork, and routine exams.

Multiple reviewers express deep gratitude to the medical team for saving pets' lives during acute crises, preventing invasive surgeries, and providing effective arthritis management. At the same time, an owner reported that treatment for a feline illness was ineffective and required transfer to another hospital, noting disappointment with diagnostic outcomes.

q.en: Does the hospital accept walk-in patients?

a.en: Yes, clients report that the clinic accommodates walk-in visits and can work in pets when other veterinary offices are fully booked.

q.en: What procedures and services are offered?

a.en: Reviewers mention routine exams, kitten wellness visits, tooth extractions, diagnostics, chronic arthritis management, and grooming.

q.en: Do veterinarians follow up after appointments?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention that staff call the following day to monitor pet recovery and ensure treatment plans are working well.
Several owners find pricing fair and transparent, though a few clients felt specific emergency exams and treatments were quite expensive.
